name: Quality Care Health Foundation
description: Quality Care Health Foundation is a non-profit 501(c)(3) educational foundation. Our goal is to provide affordable, cost-effective, in-depth training opportunities on a multitude of subjects relating to the needs of long-term care providers in California. These needs cover issues such as regulatory compliance, the Medicare reimbursement system, professional conferences, certification courses, and tools for hands-on management in long-term care facilities.
